login.tagline: Your PC backlog, sorted. Every day, the next game to play.
login.privacy: We only read your public game library. Your Steam password never reaches us.

callback.backToApp: If you use the installed app, you can go back to it now: you're already signed in there.

home.comingSoon: Your library is on its way: it arrives in the next updates.

PROFILE_PRIVATE.title: Your Steam profile is private
PROFILE_PRIVATE.body: We can't see your games until your profile is public.

GAMES_PRIVATE.title: Your Steam games are private
GAMES_PRIVATE.body: Your profile is public, but your game details aren't, so we can't see your library.

PLAYTIME_HIDDEN.title: Your playtime is hidden
PLAYTIME_HIDDEN.body: We can see your games but not your hours, and without them we can't tell what you've finished.

steps.open: Open your privacy settings on Steam.
steps.public: Set “My profile” and “Game details” to Public.
steps.playtime: Untick “Always keep my total playtime private”.

sync.title: Syncing your library
sync.firstTimeHint: The first import takes a couple of minutes: Steam limits how fast we can ask. Keep the app open in the meantime.

game.noLength: We don't know how long this game takes yet.
game.steamStore: See it on the Steam Store ↗

review.title: Catch up

reason.allAchievements: You have all {{total}} of its achievements.
reason.playtime: You’ve played {{played}} and its story takes about {{story}}.
reason.paused_one: You haven’t played it in {{count}} month ({{played}} played).
reason.paused_other: You haven’t played it in {{count}} months ({{played}} played).
reason.pausedLongAgo: You haven’t played it in a long time ({{played}} played).

review.hint: Swipe the card, or use the buttons or the arrow keys.

done.title: All reviewed!
done.body: No games left to confirm. When the app spots a new one, it shows up here.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Something in the request wasn't right. Please try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.STEAM_LOGIN_INVALID: We couldn't verify your Steam sign-in. Please try again.
errors.STEAM_UNAVAILABLE: Steam isn't responding right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.STEAM_ACCOUNT_NOT_LINKED: There's no Steam account linked to your profile.
errors.STEAM_LIBRARY_PRIVATE: Steam didn't share your library: check that your game details are public.
errors.SYNC_INTERRUPTED: The import was interrupted. Please start it again.
errors.SYNC_FAILED: The import failed. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.LIBRARY_GAME_NOT_FOUND: That game isn't in your library.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
